lines.text: Oh! You are new. I am Neilo. Shall we explore together?
Your signal is on its way! We gave each system its turn.
Tap the glowing circle to walk there.
Tap the little blue light beneath the bench.
Tap my picture whenever you need a hand.
First, connect a device at the power console.
Power is ready. Prepare water at the habitat station.
Give the radio its turn. Let’s reach your crew.
The crew can hear us. Let’s visit the growing corner.
Our garden is ready. Open the field-notes console.
We did it together. Your log remembers our plans.
Drag either seed packet into the growing tray.
Turn on the grow light, then hold the water button.
The tray is too wet. Drain a little and try again.
Conditions are ready. Start the training calendar.
We’re fast-forwarding a simulation. Real plants take weeks to grow.
Drag one plant’s harvest to the plate. Then collect the next.
Harvest collected. Simulate boiling the soybean pods before serving.
This short animation represents cooking. It is not a real cooking time.
Three harvests collected! Let’s discover the science behind your plan.
Soybeans need a longer plan. Stored meals cover the wait.
Drag both plugs into matching sockets on the same machine.
Both plugs are connected. Turn the breaker on.
The pump has power. Follow the light to the water station.
The radio is ready. Follow the light to the communication desk.
Water is ready. Pause the pump and give the radio its turn.
The radio has power. Align the antenna to hear your crew.
Water is ready and the antenna is aligned. Send your signal.
The battery needs a charge before the next job.
Read the device, date and unit above the graph.
A missing reading is not zero. Choose not available.
Mark what we know, and what still needs a measurement.
Follow the highlighted station. We’ll take one step at a time.
Hello! I am Neilo. Let’s find a way to reach your crew.
Start at the power console. Connect the pump before preparing water.
The pump is ready. Run one water cycle and watch the tank fill.
Your crew is safe in orbit. Let’s prepare our reply.
Pause the other station to free its power.
